rationale: Page @font-face faces the capture already records reach native rendering: build_native_view_tree registers font_family_assets with each rule's declared weight range (registerFont gains the same optional range for the JS lane), and bold is synthesized against that declared range as Chromium does, with a declared family keeping its own face at any weight. Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
